item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud tshe dbang gnam lcags bum pa srub med
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas shar phyogs rgyal mo rong gi gnas chen ri bo yi/ byang phyogs nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs seng gdong phug nas/ rab brtan lcags phag zla tshes nyin par rigs mthun mkha' 'gro'i grogs mdzad de/ khrom gter du bgyis shing spyan drangs pas slar zla tshes kyi nyin par pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse na shog ser bod yig du (tu) bsgyur ba grub bo//
